items.title: The cokernel of a map of adequate functors is adequate
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file adequate.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a ring A and a map phi : F -> G of adequate functors on Alg_A, the lemma asserts that the cokernel of phi is adequate (statement lines 683-692, with the author's own slogan). The proof is a two-step construction: from an injection G -> M-underlined it obtains an injection G/F -> M-underlined/F, uses the cokernel-into-module lemma to see that M-underlined/F is adequate and hence embeds into some N-underlined, and composing gets an injection G/F -> N-underlined; applying the same lemma to the induced map G -> N-underlined gives adequacy of its cokernel and an injection N-underlined/G -> K-underlined; the resulting exact sequence 0 -> G/F -> N-underlined -> K-underlined exhibits G/F as a kernel, which is adequate (proof lines 694-705). The level is H3: the argument is short but consists of a genuine two-pass construction with the embeddings exhibited at each stage.
